ModuleName: Generating a Module Breakdown from Source Material

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured list of all topics covered in this module — including uploading source material, interpreting the AI-generated breakdown, accepting, and adjusting module structures — used by instructors to see the module's scope at a glance and by learners as a navigation reference.

Artifacts.Name: How PreseMaker Analyzes Source Material
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory text page covering how PreseMaker uploads, reads, parses, and interprets source material to drive course creation, intended for learners to read before working with the platform so they understand what happens behind the scenes after an upload.

Artifacts.Name: Understanding the AI-Suggested Module Breakdown
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory text page describing what the AI-generated module breakdown looks like, how it is produced from uploaded source material, and what information each suggested module contains, helping learners understand and interpret the output PreseMaker returns after analysis.

Artifacts.Name: Accepting the Proposed Module Structure
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory text page on the process and professional judgement involved in accepting PreseMaker's proposed module structure, guiding course authors through evaluating whether the AI suggestion is ready to serve as the foundation of their course.

Artifacts.Name: Adjusting and Replacing the Module Breakdown
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory text page covering the tools PreseMaker provides for editing, reordering, rephrasing, and replacing an AI-generated module breakdown, intended to help course authors refine the initial suggestion to match their instructional vision.

Artifacts.Name: Course and Module Storage as Folders on Disk
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory text page describing how PreseMaker stores courses and modules as a transparent hierarchy of ordinary folders and files on disk, helping learners and instructors understand the one-to-one relationship between the on-screen interface and the underlying file system.

Artifacts.Name: Course and Module Storage as Folders on Disk
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory text page describing how PreseMaker stores courses and modules as a transparent hierarchy of ordinary folders and files on disk, helping learners and instructors understand the one-to-one relationship between the on-screen interface and the underlying file system.
